document.adaptation: One sentence of the quote dropped (“A country with war criminal records such as the US should never again take the term human rights into its mouth.”).
document.text: "If the U.S. makes a wrong move against Iran, energy flow in the region will be definitely put at serious risk. You [the United States] can never maintain security for [the distribution of] energy in the region. We are a peace-willing nation and our only weapon is the belief and resistance of our people," added Khamenei.
